# SEED constraints for recipes-build.sh — upstream's only guard
# (pyodide-recipes tools/constraints.txt). Used for a package ONLY until its
# frozen per-package file exists at config/recipes-constraints.d/<pkg>.txt
# (generated by `node scripts/run-recipes.mjs --freeze-constraints` from the
# AVLO-PKG-marked pip log of a full forced build, then committed).
#
# Pins are per-package because legitimate cross-package conflicts exist —
# numpy resolves Cython 3.2.8 while pandas' `Cython>3.1.0,<4.0.0a0` bound
# enables the 3.3.0a1 prerelease; matplotlib pins meson-python 0.16.x vs
# 0.20.x elsewhere — and PIP_CONSTRAINT applies to every requirement in an
# env, so one global pin file is unsatisfiable.
cmake < 4
